passage.text: Thank you for choosing the River View Hotel in Chiang Mai.
passage.reading: ˈθæŋk juː fər ˈtʃuːzɪŋ ðə ˈrɪvər ˈvjuː hoʊˈtɛl ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ.

passage.text: We are happy to confirm your reservation.
passage.reading: wiː ər ˈhæpi tə kənˈfɜːrm jʊr ˌrɛzərˈveɪʃən.

passage.text: Your arrival date is Friday, May 8th, and your departure date is Sunday, May 10th.
passage.reading: jʊr əˈraɪvəl ˈdeɪt ɪz ˈfraɪdeɪ, ˈmeɪ ˈeɪtθ, ənd jʊr dɪˈpɑːrtʃər ˈdeɪt ɪz ˈsʌndeɪ, ˈmeɪ ˈtɛnθ.

passage.text: You have booked one double room for two guests.
passage.reading: juː hæv ˈbʊkt ˈwʌn ˈdʌbəl ˈruːm fər ˈtuː ˈɡɛsts.

passage.text: It is a non-smoking room with a view of the river.
passage.reading: ɪt ɪz ə ˌnɑːnˈsmoʊkɪŋ ˈruːm wɪð ə ˈvjuː əv ðə ˈrɪvər.

passage.text: You have already paid 1,600 baht, so please pay the other 800 baht when you check in.
passage.reading: juː hæv ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈpeɪd ˌsɪkˈstiːn ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt, soʊ ˈpliːz ˈpeɪ ði ˈʌðər ˈeɪt ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt wɛn juː ˈtʃɛk ˈɪn.

passage.text: You can check in after two o'clock, and you have to check out before twelve.
passage.reading: juː kən ˈtʃɛk ˈɪn ˈæftər ˈtuː əˈklɑːk, ənd juː ˈhæf tə ˈtʃɛk ˈaʊt bɪˈfɔːr ˈtwɛlv.

passage.text: Breakfast is free, and our shuttle to the old city leaves every hour.
passage.reading: ˈbrɛkfəst ɪz ˈfriː, ənd aʊər ˈʃʌtəl tə ði ˈoʊld ˈsɪti ˈliːvz ˈɛvri ˈaʊər.

passage.text: We hope you enjoy your stay in Chiang Mai!
passage.reading: wiː ˈhoʊp juː ɪnˈdʒɔɪ jʊr ˈsteɪ ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ!
